text:
alex: deploy-bot flagged a provenance-lint failure on the promotion of redwood/inference:2026.03.18-rc3 — promotion paused. CI step failed: missing manifest label 'com.redwood.build.metadata'. anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: Promotion halted by policy (provenance-lint). Logs: `provenance-lint: missing label com.redwood.build.metadata`

maria: seeing the same in release pipeline. image present in ECR but the manifest lacks the sidecar metadata label the lint expects. build artifacts still in GCS.

samir: quick check — buildkite #3456 shows docker manifest inspect output with no labels. example:```
{
  "SchemaVersion": 2,
  "MediaType": "application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json",
  "config": { ... },
  "annotations": {}
}
```

sre-jen: options: 1) rollback promotion (revert to previous tag) or 2) republish the same digest with injected metadata. Important: changing manifest annotations will change manifest digest and invalidate existing cosign signature. We should republish from signed build artifacts and re-sign. which do we prefer?

alex: prefer republish+resign if artifacts exist — avoid reverting user-facing tag. @deploy-bot can you run cosign verify on the current digest?

deploy-bot: cosign verify redwood/inference:2026.03.18-rc3 -> OK for digest sha256:abc123def. Note: injecting annotations will produce a new manifest digest and will require a new signature.

maria: we have the build bundle in gs://redwood-builds/2026-03-18/rc3. I can run our republish tool to reconstruct the manifest with the required `com.redwood.build.metadata` label and then sign. ETA ~15m.

alex: :thumbsup: proceed. Hold promotions for 30m change window — no prod deploys until we confirm. @sre-jen please pause automated promotions. Update release notes after republish.

sre-jen: pausing automated promotions now and setting manual hold in deploybot for 30m. I'll alert #incidents if this extends.

maria: starting republish:```
republish --src gs://redwood-builds/2026-03-18/rc3 \
  --target ecr://us-west-2/redwood/inference:2026.03.18-rc3 \
  --annotations "com.redwood.build.metadata={\"build_id\":\"bk-3456\",\"commit\":\"f1e2d3\"}" \
  --sign-with ksm://releases/key-2026
```

deploy-bot: republish job started by maria. monitoring logs.

maria: republish finished, re-signed. New manifest digest sha256:deadbeef. I pushed and promoted to staging, then triggered deploybot promotion to prod.

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed and completed. New digest sha256:deadbeef. cosign verify OK. Release notes updated: "2026.03.18-rc3 republished to include provenance metadata and re-signed; no runtime changes."

alex: thanks everyone. closing thread — note for postmortem: add a lint gate to the build jobs so the label is guaranteed before publishing, and update docs for metadata-injector flow.
